$schema: Layer 0 bootstrap configuration - SAMPLE. The application reads bootstrap.json from this directory, never this file. To customise, copy this file to bootstrap.json beside it and edit the copy. Every key is optional; anything omitted falls back to the value compiled into the application, and these values are those defaults, so having no bootstrap.json behaves exactly like an unedited copy of this sample.
$upgrade: The marketplace package owns this sample and replaces it on every upgrade, so do not edit it. It never installs, replaces or deletes bootstrap.json, so your copy survives an upgrade and also an uninstall. Keep bootstrap.json in nxserver/nuxeo.war/agentic-ui-config - not in nxserver/web or in the agentic-ui bundle directory, which the installer replaces. Both files are served without authentication: put nothing secret in either.
$nuxeoApiOrigin: Origin for Nuxeo REST calls. Leave empty for same-origin deployments.
$nuxeoServerUrl: Nuxeo as seen by external clients such as Nuxeo Drive. null derives it from the browser location.
$manifestDocumentPath: Repository path of the Nuxeo document holding the runtime manifest. Absent is fine: the application falls back to its packaged defaults.
$themes: Merged over the packaged themes by id. 'tokens' are CSS custom properties applied to <html> while the theme is active, so a rebrand needs no rebuild. Add an entry with a new id to add a whole theme.
